<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex62042025-05-2010-57-04" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone n="Conclusive verses" unit="section"/>
        <lg><l>theg chen mthar thug 'khor 'das de nyid don ||</l> <l>rab ston 'phags pa'i gsung rab legs bshad pas ||</l> <l>dga' ldan skyes nas byams mgon mnyes byas te ||</l> <l>byang chub lung bstan myur du thob <pb n="15b"/><lb n="15b1"/> par shog ||</l></lg>
      
        <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex62042024-10-1812-11-29" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"> <milestone n="Colophon" unit="section"/>
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5111"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3749">theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma</rs> rgyan gyi me tog</rs> ces bya ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4006">mang du thos pa'i dge slong bcom ldan ral gri</rs>s sbyar ba rdzogs so || mang+ga laM ||</seg></seg></TEI>
